subject: reasoning
question:
Which of the given letter-clusters will replace the question mark (?) in the following series?

FBID, ICMF, LDQH, ?, RFYL
solution:
According to the English alphabets and their positional values:**
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7d12502c2ca7d9724c6b72807e815218baf7d8f4c343b106b5314067691645b.png] 
The pattern followed in the given series is:

 First alphabet is increased to 3 positional values.**

 Second alphabet is increased to 1 positional values.

 Third alphabet is increased to 4 positional values.

 Fourth alphabet is increased to 2 positional values.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/429df0c549682ffd4f3840798f67b81aacd50157c8632573dbf3d7af18d2619b.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is** "option (2)".**
